Thanks again for taking the time to meet yesterday — really appreciated the context on Atlas Analytics' priority around customer-facing search and the need to bring down inference cost for real-time suggestions. I promised to send over the recording and the slides, so attaching both here and dropping the links below.

Quick recap / next steps I took from our call:
- Primary use case: real-time search suggestions for web product (low latency, high QPS)
- Key constraints: <50ms p99 latency target, data residency in us-east-1, SOC2 required
- Things we can help with: Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, prefix caching to lower per-token cost, and Private deployment options for compliance

If it helps, I'd be happy to do a quick 20-minute Q&A with your infra/ML folks to walk through the performance profile and the recommended rollout plan (model variants + canary strategy). Proposed times next week:
- Tue 3/3 10:00–10:20 PT
- Wed 3/4 11:30–11:50 PT
- Thu 3/5 09:00–09:20 PT

If none of those work, tell me a preferred window and we’ll make it happen. Vivek (cc'd) will join to talk about dedicated sizing and SLAs.

Thanks,

--
